description: The chronic form of pityriasis lichenoides, an uncommon cutaneous eruption of uncertain cause.
causes: Cause is unknown; proposed mechanisms include hypersensitivity reactions, medication-associated inflammation, and other immune processes.

appearance.general: Multiple small erythematous or brown papules, often with mica-like scale and lesions at different stages of evolution.
appearance.dark_skin: Dark-skinned patients may have widespread hypopigmentation and more subtle diagnostic signs.
